ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across 85-90% of the surface area with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered micro-regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white pixel clusters at the lateral terminations of both lobes; secondary mapping shows sparse, small-diameter white circular blobs (approximately 2-10 pixels in diameter) distributed across the dark medial fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing a depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the posterior boundary of both lobes; peaks and valleys exhibit irregular pixel-amplitude variations across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sloping convex curves originating from the median notch and tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme left and right tips, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment sites; additional isolated white circular spots present on the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy textural encrustations and high-contrast scarring concentrated on the distal-most lateral edges of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of high-contrast pixel clusters specifically localized to the extreme outer tips, creating a highly irregular edge boundary compared to the more uniform serration of the inner trailing edge.
